rows.surface: Byte-identical registry derivation in Objective-C and Objective-C++ consumers
rows.mechanism: An explicit const byte-pointer cast allows the same registry header to compile in Logos Objective-C++ mode without changing hash bytes or algorithm. Fixed pre-refactor golden bundle/group vectors execute in both language modes.

evidence.detail: Type-only cast; FNV offset basis and bytes remain unchanged.
Actual native fixed-vector test now compiles/runs in both language modes.

rows.verification: Real ldid build failed at the previous implicit const void-pointer conversion; the expanded native test reproduced the same failure first, then both modes passed after the one-line cast.
rows.fix: Retain both compilation modes in the build regression gate.
